[[Phantom (NPC)|Phantom]]s are [[mesmer]]s that can be found on the [[Ring of Fire Islands]]. Although they do little damage, they are quite proficient at shutting down your team, often [[popup|popping up]] at inopportune times.

==Locations==
*[[Ring of Fire Islands]]
**{{NPC location|Perdition Rock}}

*Ring of Fire Islands
**{{NPC location|Ring of Fire}}

*{{skill icon|Cry of Frustration}}
*{{skill icon|Drain Enchantment}}
*{{skill icon|Power Drain}}
*{{skill icon|Power Leak}}
*{{skill icon|Signet of Midnight}} ([[elite]])

==Notes==
*Unlike most ghosts, [[holy damage]] is doubled against Phantoms.

==Trivia==
* The appearance of the Phantoms was inspired by [[w:H. P. Lovecraft|H. P. Lovecraft]] works and were originally intended for [[creature]]s of the [[Maguuma Jungle]].
